Fiddlehead soft shield-fern croziers pushing silver-furred from compressed hornbeam leaf litter, rust-red and acid-yellow sphagnum hummocks swelling from a flooded hollow, dew droplets magnifying the fine parallel veins on broad creeping-jenny leaves, water rippling in slow concentric rings beneath a steady trickle off a moss-furred root overhang

Crinkled foliose lichen in pale ochre and burnt-sienna colonising every plate of a standing dead field-maple, dew-heavy orb-weaver web sagging between two greater stitchwort stems under accumulated droplets, scattered sulphur-tuft mushroom clusters lemon-yellow at a rotting lime-tree root base, water droplets rolling slowly down the ribbed corrugated surface of creeping-jenny leaves

Deeply plated sessile-oak bark creviced with pale jade and rust-orange crustose lichen in every groove, dew films coating the tightly coiled croziers of ostrich-fern emerging copper-furred from black peaty soil, scattered jelly-ear fungi in translucent amber-brown cupping along a mossy fallen wych-elm limb, pollen dust yellowing the still water surface at the shaded pool margin

Springy bog-moss in vivid rust-red hummocks blanketing every exposed stone along the stream margin, dew droplets suspended in trembling rows along every radiating strand of a funnel-web between dock-leaf stems, pale cobalt and burnt-ochre crustose lichen spreading across a wet basalt face, scattered waxcap mushrooms in deep crimson across the open needle-litter floor
